blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share of tokens just before the onset that it flags, largely by flagging degenerate responses long before the onset, and no untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms. We release the probes with calibrated thresholds at https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes
blocks.zh: 许多语言模型的失败始于特定的符号,即开始. 在生成过程中读取模型的显示器可以对完成的响应进行分类,一旦发生故障即检测故障,或在启动前发出警告,只有警告才会留下停止或引导生成的时间. 监测器通常使用AUROC等响应级的度量衡来评价,在监测器失火时会忽略. 我们引入了PREWARN, 任何失败的评估协议 附带说明的开始。 它将每个显示器在验证数据的阈值校准为为应用程序选择的误差率,运行显示器,并在所有三项任务上将其警报相对于触发的计分. 作为案例研究,我们把它应用于三个开放语言模型的重复退化,以预警为主要任务,在激活时使用线性探测器和6个未经训练的基线。 反应级的度量衡对这次故障的饱和度,而只读取反应长度得分的规则几乎完美无缺,同时探测到AUROC在PREWARN下作为等效警告的排名非常不同. 探测器在发端前警告三种模型中两种最退化的反应,探测器以下的低等级适配器在发端前的信号量比它所悬挂的信号量多一倍以上,主要是在发端前很长的一段时间内,通过标注变质反应,没有未经训练的基线比随机警报更经常发出警告. 我们在https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodne/prewarn-degeneration-probes上发布了带有校准阈值的探测器

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset . From that token on, a response may, for example, turn harmful ( Li et al., 2025 ) , make unsupported claims ( Niu et al., 2024 ) , or fall into a repetition loop that runs until the token budget is exhausted ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ; Welleck et al., 2020 ; Pipis et al., 2026 ) . A monitor that reads the model during generation can serve three tasks: response classification gives one verdict on the finished response, failure detection raises an alarm once the failure is under way, and early warning raises one before it begins. Only an early warning leaves time to stop, steer or resample the generation before any of the failure is produced ( Li et al., 2025 ; Hedström et al., 2025 ; Zhang and others, 2025 ) . We ask how such monitors should be evaluated, focusing on early warning, with repetitive degeneration as the case study.
blocks.zh: 许多语言模型的失败始于一个特定的标志,即开始。 例如,从这一迹象开始,反应可能变得有害(Li等人,2025年),提出无根据的主张(Niu等人,2024年),或陷入重复循环,一直持续到迹象预算用尽(Holtzman等人,2020年;Welleck等人,2020年;Pipis等人,2026年)。 一个在生成期间读取模型的显示器可以服务于三个任务:反应分类对完成的响应给出一个判断,故障检测在故障发生后引起警报,预警在启动前提出一个. 在任何故障发生之前,只有预警留下时间来阻止、引导或重新模拟这一代人(Li等人,2025年;Hedström等人,2025年;张等,2025年)。 我们问,应如何评估这些监测员,重点是早期预警,并将重复的退化作为案例研究。

blocks.en: Linear probes on model activations are a cheap way to build such monitors. They have been trained to detect deception ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) , high-stakes interactions ( McKenzie et al., 2025 ) , hallucinated entities ( Obeso et al., 2025 ) and repetition loops ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Duan et al., 2026 ) , and are scored as classifiers of whole responses, entities, text chunks or sentences, with AUROC, accuracy, F 1 F_{1} or recall at a fixed false-positive rate. Because every unit after the onset counts as a positive, these metrics reward flagging the failure, not flagging it early. A probe that fires only once the failure is visible in the text scores as well as one that fires before it begins ( Figure 1 , left).
blocks.zh: 模型激活上的线性探测器是建造这种监视器的廉价方法. 他们接受了检测欺骗(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025年),高吸积相互作用(McKenzie等人,2025年),幻觉实体(Obeso等人,2025年)和重复循环(Xie等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年;Duan等人,2026年)的培训,被打成整体反应的分类器,实体,文本块或句子,有AUROC,精确度,F 1F_{1}或以固定的假阳性率召回. 因为每一个单位在发病后都算为阳性,这些衡量标准奖励标注失败,而不是提前标注失败. 探测器只有在文本分数中显示故障时才开火,以及在开始前开火(图1,左)。

blocks.en: To score early warning, an evaluation needs two things: an annotated onset, so that alarms before it can be scored separately from those after it, and a threshold fixed in advance at the error rate the monitor will be deployed with, so that the monitor is evaluated as it will be used. Evaluations that report timing each miss at least one of these. Li et al. (2025) report how much of the response their monitor of harmful content reads before stopping it, not whether the harm had already begun. Evaluations that locate the onset either count an earlier alarm the same as one raised in the first unsafe sentence ( Kavumba et al., 2026 ) or give it no credit ( Qwen Team, 2025 ; Itkin, 2026 ) . Huang et al. (2026) fix the false-alarm rate, but label only whether a run failed, so they measure how early an alarm comes from the end of the run. Duan et al. (2026) credit only alarms raised before repetition starts, but tune their threshold for detection. Section A.1 covers related work in full.
blocks.zh: 为了给预警打分,评价需要两样东西:一是附加说明的触发,这样警报才能与之后的警报分开打分,一是事先按错误率设定的阈值,显示器会被部署,这样就可以按使用时评价显示器. 报告时间安排的评价至少少了一个。 Li等人(2025年)报告说,他们在停止有害内容监测器之前所看到的反应有多少,而不是损害是否已经开始。 确定发端位置的评价要么算上与第一个不安全句子(Kavumba等人,2026年)提出的警报相同的较早警报,要么不记名(Quen Team,2025年;Itkin,2026年)。 Huang等人(2026年)修补了假警报率,但只标注运行失败与否,因此他们测量了运行结束时警报的来龙去脉. 杜安等编. (2026年)信用只在重复开始前提出警报,但调整其阈值进行检测. A.1节全面涵盖有关工作。

blocks.en: We propose Prewarn ( pre-onset warning evaluation ), a protocol for monitors of any failure with an annotated onset. It fixes each monitor’s threshold on validation data at a chosen error rate and evaluates the monitor on each of the three tasks, measuring its alarms relative to the onset ( Figure 1 , right). Which error to fix, and at what rate, depends on the failure at hand. For repetitive degeneration we fix the share of healthy (non-degenerate) responses that raise an alarm, the false-alarm budget . For harmful content, a missed failure can cost more than a false alarm ( Li et al., 2025 ) , so one may instead fix the false-negative rate.
blocks.zh: 我们提议Prewarn(预设警告评估), 它以选定的误差率确定每个显示器对验证数据的阈值,并评价三个任务中的每一个任务的显示器,衡量其相对于触发的警报(图1,右方)。 哪些错误需要修正,以何种速度,取决于手头的失败. 对于重复的退化,我们固定健康(非退化)反应的比例,这些反应引起警报,即虚假警报预算。 对于有害内容,误失的失败成本可能超过假警报(Li等人,2025年),所以人们可能改用假负率.

blocks.en: We apply Prewarn to repetitive degeneration in Apertus-8B-Instruct ( Project Apertus, 2025 ) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and Mistral-7B-Instruct ( Jiang and others, 2023 ) , sampled stochastically without balancing the classes, and test whether response-level metrics, the standard for response classification, also identify the monitors that warn early. For repetitive degeneration they do not. Only a few percent of responses degenerate, so a monitor that never alarms is highly accurate, and since every degenerate response runs to the token limit, a rule that only checks length reaches an almost perfect AUROC, though it fires only once the budget is spent and so can never warn.

blocks.en: Probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under Prewarn , and on Apertus , selecting by AUROC picks one that warns less. Frozen probes, which read the model’s own activations, raise their first alarm before the onset on most loops of Apertus and Llama , while on Mistral they mostly fire after the onset and work better as detectors. Low-rank adapters trained below the probe more than double how much of the window just before the onset it flags, mostly with flags long before it, but barely raise how often the first alarm precedes it. None of six untrained baselines, which read only the text or the model’s confidence, warns much more often than random alarms.

blocks.en: Prewarn evaluates a monitor on the three tasks for any failure with an onset. It needs the token scores of a scorer on a validation and a test split, the labels of both splits, that is, which responses fail and where their onset lies, and an error budget β \beta , the highest rate of one kind of error the monitor may make. Which error is bounded, and at what rate, depends on the task and the application, and is left to whoever deploys the monitor. The protocol has three steps.

blocks.en: On response classification the four scorers are indistinguishable, and the token-cap rule reaches the highest best accuracy ( Figure 2 a). The detection rate, which like AUROC counts whole responses, is close to 1 1 for all four ( Figure 2 b). Differences appear only in the metrics that take the onset into account. Post-onset coverage singles out the token-cap rule, which flags almost none of the loop, while the three probes flag most of it ( Figure 2 b). The early-warning metrics also differ between the three probes, and warning coverage, which our selection rule uses, differs most, with the adapted probe covering more than three times as much of the warning window as either frozen probe ( Figure 2 c). Response-level metrics miss these differences because they score a response by its highest token score, wherever that token lies. For example, keeping only that token, which usually lies deep inside the loop, removes almost every early warning but leaves AUROC unchanged ( Table 4 in Section A.5 ). The same pattern holds across layers ( Figure 2 d). AUROC, which is 0.5 0.5 for a random scorer and 1 1 for a perfect one, stays above 0.96 0.96 at every layer, and best accuracy varies by less than 3 % 3\% , so every layer separates degenerate from healthy responses about equally well. Warning coverage is seven times higher at the best layer than at the worst, so the early signs of degeneration are much easier to read at some layers than at others.
blocks.zh: 在响应分类上,四个得分者是无法区分的,而令牌盖规则达到最高的准确度(图2a)。 与AUROC一样,检测率将全部答复计算在内,所有四个答复都接近1.1(图2b)。 差异只出现在考虑到开始的衡量尺度中。 安装后的报道单挑出符号封面规则,该规则标注了几乎零环,而三个探测器标注了大部分(图2b). 预警指标在三种探测器之间也有所不同,而我们选择规则使用的预警覆盖范围差异最大,经过调整的探测器覆盖的预警窗口比冷冻探测器多三倍以上(图2c)。 反应层面的衡量标准忽略了这些差异,因为它们以最高的符号得分来评分,无论该符号在哪里。 例如,只保留通常位于环内深处的该标志,几乎可以删除每一项预警,但AUROC保持不变(A.5节表4)。 同样的模式存在于各层(图2d)。 AUROC,随机计分器为0.5 0.5,完美计分器为1 1,每层停留在0.96 0.96以上,最佳精度变化小于3% 3\%,因此每层都与健康反应相分离,大致相同。 警告覆盖率在最佳层比最坏层高7倍,因此早期的退化迹象在一些层比其他层更容易阅读.

The ranking by AUROC reproduces itself on test (Kendall’s τ = 0.79 \tau=0.79 , against 0.53 0.53 for best accuracy), so the ordering of AUROC is not noise, but it agrees only weakly with the test ranking by warning coverage ( τ = 0.33 \tau=0.33 ). The ranking by validation warning coverage predicts it closely ( τ = 0.94 \tau=0.94 ), so our selection rule uses validation warning coverage. For example, at layer 15 15 , selecting by validation AUROC would pick a frozen probe that covers less than a third as much of the warning window as the adapted probe.
blocks.zh: 在图2 a 和图2 d 的缩放中,响应级的度量衡在计分器和分层之间差别不大,但它们仍然显示命令. 我们按每个度量对表3的27个探测器进行验证,并与它们在试验中的排名进行比较(表5)。 AUROC的排名在测试上自行复制(Kendall的 \ = 0.79\ tau= 0.79,对最准确的 0.53 0.53),因此AUROC的订购不是噪音,而是对通过警告覆盖进行的测试排名(\ = 0.33\ tau= 0.33)的微弱认同. 按审定警示范围排列的排名,可以近距离预测(\\\=0.94\tau=0.94),因此我们的选取规则使用审定警示范围. 例如,在第15 15 层,通过验证选择AUROC将选择一个覆盖不到三分之一的警告窗口的冷冻探测器作为经过调整的探测器。

blocks.en: 4.3 Q2: Do linear probes warn before the onset on every model?
blocks.zh: 4.3 Q2: 线性探测器是否在每个模型发生前发出警告?

blocks.en: Since only the onset-aligned metrics tell scorers apart by when they fire, we use them from here on, and ask whether the probes trained for early warning ( Section 3 ) warn before the onset, and on which models.
blocks.zh: 由于只有发端对应的度量衡显示得分者在开火时不同,我们从这里开始使用,并询问受过预警训练的探测器(第3节)是否在发端前发出警告,以及针对哪个模型发出警告.

blocks.en: On Apertus and Llama the early-warning rate of the frozen and the adapted probe is above one half and well above that of random alarms, and the median first alarm comes 137 137 to 232 232 tokens before the onset ( Figure 3 c,d). The probes also flag a larger share of the warning window than of tokens before it, with warning coverage 1.4 1.4 to 3 3 times pre-window coverage ( Figure 3 b), which suggests a signal of the coming loop.
blocks.zh: 在Apertus和Llama上,冷冻器和经调整的探测器的预警率超过一半,远远高于随机警报,中位第一警报在发作前是137至232个令牌(图3 c,d). 探测器还标出了警告窗口比之前的标志更大的份额,警告覆盖度为窗口前覆盖的1.41.4至3倍(图3b),这表明即将出现的环路信号.

blocks.en: On Mistral the early-warning rate of every probe stays below one half, although above that of random alarms, and the median first alarm comes after the onset ( Figure 3 c,d). Warning coverage is close to pre-window coverage, so the probes flag the same share of tokens in the warning window as before it and find no clear signal of the approaching loop ( Figure 3 b). Their detection rate is still 0.99 0.99 ( Table 1 ), so on Mistral the probes are useful for failure detection but not for early warning. This holds for adapted probes too. Adaptation cannot add information absent from the response so far, only make it easier for a linear probe to read, so on Mistral the signal of the coming loop may be weak or absent until the loop begins ( Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在Mistral上,每个探测器的预警率保持在一半以下,虽然高于随机警报,而中位数第一个警报是在发作后发出的(图3 c,d)。 警告覆盖接近窗前覆盖,因此探测器在警告窗口中标出与前作相同比例的令牌,没有发现接近环路的明确信号(图3b). 它们的探测率仍然是0.99 0.99(表1),因此在米斯特拉尔,探测器对故障探测有用,但对预警却无用. 这对适应性探测器也是有利的 适应无法添加迄今为止反应中缺失的信息,只能使线性探测器更容易读取,因此对于Mistral来说,来回循环的信号在循环开始前可能很弱或没有(第4.4节).

blocks.en: At the 5 % 5\% budget, the thresholds fixed on validation give every probe a false-alarm rate of 4.5 % 4.5\% to 5.6 % 5.6\% on test and below 1 % 1\% on the held-out sources ( Table 12 in Section A.7 ). There, the frozen probes of Llama and Mistral still raise an alarm on almost every degenerate response, but their early-warning rate drops to 0.20 0.20 and 0.12 0.12 and their median first alarm comes after the onset. The adapted probes degrade less and warn before almost all of the 24 24 degenerate held-out responses of Apertus .

blocks.en: We first compare the frozen probe with the adapted probe at the same layer, which differ only by the LoRA adapters. On every model adaptation more than doubles warning coverage and raises post-onset coverage, but it barely raises the early-warning rate ( Table 1 ), so most of the early warning is already present in the frozen probe. The early-warning rate counts a response once, at its first alarm, so adding flags to a response that already has one before the onset does not raise it. Pre-window coverage rises with warning coverage, so many of the added flags fall long before the onset. Reading the adapted probe at its own layer shows the same behaviour. Since the probe stays linear, these changes come from the representation it reads. In Section A.10 we project the activations of one degenerate response per model onto their first two principal components and show that, at the frozen probe’s layer, the tokens before the warning window, in it and after the onset overlap, while after adaptation they fall in largely separate regions ( Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先将冰冻探测器与同一层的经改造探测器进行比较,这些探测器仅与LORA适配器不同. 在每一个模型的适应上,都不止是双倍的预警覆盖,并提高了设定后的覆盖度,但是它几乎没有提高预警率(表1),所以大部分预警已经存在于冷冻探测器中. 预警率在第一次警报时算作一次响应,因此在发信号前已经有一个响应的响应中加挂旗帜并不提高. 窗口前的覆盖随着警告的覆盖而上升,因此许多新增的旗帜早在爆发前就已经倒下. 在自己的地层读取经过改造的探测器显示出同样的行为. 由于探测器保持线性,这些变化来自于它所读到的表示. 在A.10节中,我们将每个模型一个变质反应的激活投射到其前两个主要部件上,并显示在冷冻探测器的层层,警告窗口之前、警告窗口中和发出之后的信号重叠,而在适应后,这些信号主要落在不同的区域(图6)。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows where the added flags fall. On Apertus and Llama the frozen probe flags more tokens as the onset approaches. The adapted probes show the same rise, shifted up by a level of flags already present more than a thousand tokens before the onset (top row). Much of the gain therefore comes from flags spread over the whole degenerate response, as for the long-window repetition rules of Section 4.5 . On healthy responses every probe flags more the longer the response runs (bottom row). On Apertus the adapted probes flag more of a degenerate response long before its onset than of a healthy response at any of the first 2,048 2{,}048 positions, which suggests a judgement, made long before the onset, that the response will degenerate. On Llama healthy responses reach the same level once they run long enough, so these flags may partly reflect how long the response has run. On both models the onset typically comes after a healthy response has ended, so position alone carries part of the label, and the probes may partly rely on it.
blocks.zh: 图4显示新增旗帜落地. 在Apertus和Llama上 冰冻的探测器会随着发光的临近而增加标记 改编的探测器显示同样的上升,被升降前已经出现超过一千个令牌(上行)的旗帜水平上移. 因此,大部分收益来自旗帜遍布整个退化的反应,如第4.5节的长窗重复规则。 在健康反应上,每个探测器的旗子 反应持续的时间越长(下行)。 在Apertus上,经过改造的探测器在发作前很久就标出了一种退化的反应,而不是在前2,048 2{,}048个位置中的任何一种健康的反应,这表明在发作前很久作出的判断是反应会退化。 在Llama的健康反应一旦持续足够长的时间就达到同一水平,因此这些旗帜可能部分反映了反应持续的时间. 在两种模型中,发病一般是在健康反应结束后发生的,因此单是位置就带有部分标签,探测器可能部分依赖它.

blocks.en: On Mistral all three probes flag every position before the onset at about the same rate and rise only after it. Adaptation raises this rate without adding a rise toward the onset, which keeps warning coverage close to pre-window coverage ( Figure 3 b).
blocks.zh: 在Mistral上,所有三个探测器在发光前的每个位置上都标注着大约相同的速度,并且只在发光后上升. 适应提高了这一比率,但没有在发病前增加上升率,这使预警覆盖面接近窗口前覆盖(图3b)。

blocks.en: As in Q1 , response classification tells the scorers apart least. Every scorer but random alarms and the repeated- n n -gram rule on Llama has an AUROC above 0.95 0.95 , and the token-cap rule has the highest AUROC on Llama and Mistral , although its only flag falls on the last token of a capped response, after the loop has filled the budget. On Apertus the adapted probe at layer 30 30 , which covers the most of the warning window, has a lower AUROC than both the token-cap rule and rep / ℓ /\ell . Ranking by AUROC would again not select the scorers that warn.
blocks.zh: 与Q1一样,响应分类对计分者分辨最少. 每个计分员但随机警报和Llama上重复的n-gram规则的AUROC高于0.95 0.95 ,而符号封顶规则在Llama和Mistral上拥有最高的AUROC,虽然其唯一一面旗帜落在封顶响应的最后一个符号上,在循环填充预算之后. 在Apertus上,30层的经过改造的探测器覆盖了大部分的警告窗口,它的AUROC比标志盖规则和代表/l/\ell都低。 由AUROC的排名将再次不选择警告的计分者.

blocks.en: Every scorer raises an alarm on at least 81 % 81\% of the degenerate responses, and most on nearly all of them, so the ranking on failure detection comes down to post-onset coverage. The adapted probes flag the largest share of the loop on Apertus and Llama , while on Mistral windowed seq-rep- n n and rep / ℓ /\ell flag more. The text baselines measure repetition in the emitted tokens, which appears only once the loop has completed its first cycle, and the confidence baselines measure how confidently the generator predicts the next token, which rises only once tokens repeat the previous cycle. Both appear after the onset, so these baselines can detect the loop but not warn of it.
blocks.zh: 每个计分员对至少81%的81%的堕落反应都发出警报,大多数都针对几乎所有的,因此故障检测的排名降为后置覆盖. 改编的探测器在Apertus和Llama上标出最大份额的环形旗,而在Mistral上则标出以下后缀-rep-n和代表/l/\ell旗。 文字基线测量所发射的符号中的重复,它只在环路完成第一个周期后才出现,信心基线测量生成者如何自信地预测下一个符号,它只在符号重复上一个周期时才会上升. 两者在发作后出现,因此这些基线可以探测到环线,但不会发出警告.

blocks.en: On every model the probes have the highest early-warning rate and the earliest median first alarm, and on Apertus and Llama they are the only scorers with an early-warning rate above one half. No baseline warns much more often than random alarms, and the token-cap, repeated- n n -gram and confidence rules warn less often. Windowed seq-rep- n n and rep / ℓ /\ell cover more of the warning window than the frozen probe on every model, but warning coverage is not read alone ( Section 3 ). They flag much of the text before the warning window too (Pre), and their first alarm comes well after the onset, so they do not pick up the coming loop but flag much of the response. Both select windows of 1,024 1{,}024 to 4,096 4{,}096 tokens on validation ( Tables 8 and 9 ), so their score measures how repetitive the response has been so far, and a response that repeats itself from the start is flagged throughout, warning window included. The adapted probe at its own layer still flags 2.5 2.5 and 1.5 1.5 times as much of the warning window as the best baseline on Apertus and Llama and is within one standard deviation of windowed seq-rep- n n on Mistral .
blocks.zh: 在每个模型上,探测器有最高的预警率和最早的中位数第一警报,在Apertus和Llama上,它们是唯一一个预警率超过一半的得分者。 没有比随机警报更频繁的基线警告,而代号-cap,重复-n-gram和信任规则警告次数更少. 窗口后继-rep-n和代表 / l/\ell覆盖的警告窗口比每个模型上的冷冻探测器多,但警告覆盖不单独阅读(第3节)。 他们也在警告窗口前标出大部分文字(Pre), 他们的第一个警报在发作后很早才发出, 因此他们不会接上即将出现的回路, 而是标出大部分响应。 二者在验证时都选择了1,024 1{,}024至4,096 4{,}096个令牌的窗口(表8和表9),因此他们的分数衡量了迄今为止反应的重复性,从一开始重复的响应会一直标出,包括警告窗口. 该探测器在自己的地层上仍标有2.5 2.5和1.5 1.5倍的警告窗口,是Apertus和Llama上的最佳基线,在Mistral上的窗口后立p-n的标准偏差范围内。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We asked how a token-level monitor of a language model failure should be evaluated, and whether linear probes on activations can warn of repetitive degeneration before it begins. Response-level metrics score whether a response fails, not when a monitor fires, and for repetitive degeneration they rate every scorer as near-perfect, including a length-only rule. Prewarn instead calibrates the threshold on validation data at whichever error rate the task calls for, runs the monitor with that threshold, and scores every alarm against the annotated onset on all three tasks ( Section 3 ). It needs only token scores, annotated onsets and an error budget, so it applies to any failure with an onset, such as harmful content ( Li et al., 2025 ) or hallucinated entities ( Obeso et al., 2025 ) , which we leave to future work. Under Prewarn , probes that response-level metrics rate as equal differ widely in how much they warn ( Section 4.2 ). Probes on Apertus and Llama fire before the onset on most of the loops they flag, while on Mistral their median alarm comes after the onset ( Section 4.3 ). Low-rank adaptation below the probe more than doubles warning coverage on every model, mostly with flags long before the onset, while the early-warning rate rises little ( Section 4.4 ). No untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms ( Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们询问,应如何评估语言模型故障的符号级监测器,激活时的线性探测器是否可以在启动前警告重复退化。 反应水平的衡量标准是,反应是否失败,而不是监测器失火时,对于重复的退化,它们将每个计分员评为接近完美,包括一个长度仅限的规则。 Prewarn将验证数据的阈值按任务要求的误差率进行校准,用该阈值运行显示器,并将所有三项任务的每个提醒与附加说明的触发值进行计分(第3节)。 它只需要象征性的分数,附加说明的发作和错误的预算,所以它适用于任何发作的失败,如有害内容(Li等人,2025年)或幻觉实体(Obeso等人,2025年),我们留待未来工作. 在Prewarn 下,探测到反应水平的度量衡在警告程度上大不相同(第4.2节)。 探测到Apertus和Llama的火在它们所标出的多数环线发生之前,而Mistral的中位警报则在爆发之后发出(第4.3节)。 探测器下方的低等级适应量超过每个型号的双倍预警覆盖量,大多在发端前很长一段时间内都悬挂着旗帜,而预警率则很少上升(第4.4节). 没有比随机警报更经常发出未经训练的基线警告(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: The two kinds of probe suit different deployments. A frozen probe reads the generator’s own activations at no extra cost and already provides most of the early warning. An adapted probe flags much more of the warning window and of the loop, at the cost of a second forward pass through the adapted layers. On a model like Mistral , where neither warns before most loops, a probe is better used as a detector. Because the probes we release come with thresholds calibrated at 1 % 1\% , 5 % 5\% and 10 % 10\% , they can directly trigger an intervention, such as stopping, resampling or steering the generation before the loop begins, a direction we have not yet explored.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: First, the lead times depend on the onset convention. We place the onset at the first token of the first loop, before the repetition is visible in the text, and a later convention would make every alarm come earlier relative to the onset. Second, under our definition of degeneration, a response that loops and then emits the end-of-sequence token counts as healthy, so our false-alarm rates are conservative. Third, some prompts call for repetition that is requested or informative, such as explicit requests to repeat, enumerations, brute-force search or code. These responses are labelled healthy, but we do not test whether the probes can tell such repetition apart from degeneration. Fourth, on Apertus and Llama the onset usually comes after a healthy response has ended, so part of what the probes flag may reflect how long the response has run ( Section 4.4 ). Fifth, the training strategy and selection rule of Section 3 were chosen on degeneration alone. Another failure may call for a different strategy, or for scorers other than linear probes.

blocks.en: Linear probes on activations classify deceptive responses [ Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ] , reporting recall at a fixed false-positive rate on control data, classify high-stakes interactions [ McKenzie et al., 2025 ] , and flag hallucinated entities while they are generated [ Obeso et al., 2025 ] . Probes on prompt activations can also predict response-level behaviours, such as format failures or jailbreak compliance, before generation starts [ Ashok and May, 2025 ] , but each prompt then gets a single prediction, so timing within the response is not evaluated. Streaming monitors of harmful content read each prefix and can halt the output [ Li et al., 2025 , Qwen Team, 2025 ] , and Kavumba et al. [2026] forecast the harm of likely continuations from a prefix. Kavumba et al. [2026] count an alarm as timely if it fires by the end of the first unsafe sentence, so an alarm raised before the unsafe content begins and one raised partway through that sentence count the same. Qwen Team [2025] count an alarm as a hit only if it falls inside that sentence and report earlier alarms separately, without credit. StreamGuard reports false positives at a default threshold, and the latency evaluation of Qwen3Guard contains only unsafe responses. Sing Team [2026] annotate where the unsafe part starts but score guards only with response- and token-level AUROC. Itkin [2026] measures the delay of hallucination detectors after the annotated onset at a fixed per-token false-alarm rate, and charges an alarm raised before the onset as a miss. PreAct-Bench [ Xu et al., 2026 ] asks LLM judges, guard models and a linear probe to predict, from an agent trajectory cut before the first overtly unethical step, whether the agent will act unethically, and scores them by F 1 F_{1} on balanced pairs without a false-alarm budget. Concurrent work fixes the false-alarm rate of language-model monitors on runs without the failure [ Schirmer et al., 2026 , Dubey, 2026 , Gao, 2026 , Huang et al., 2026 ] and argues that AUROC does not establish a valid alarm policy [ Gao, 2026 ] , but none credits alarms raised before an annotated onset. Huang et al. [2026] warn of failures in agent runs at a budget set on successful runs, but take their labels from the final outcome only and measure lead time from the end of the run.

Seizure prediction evaluates
sensitivity together with the false prediction rate, for a given prediction
horizon and occurrence period [ Winterhalder and others, 2003 ] , and clinical
systems count an event as caught if an alarm fires within a window before it,
reporting precision and alarms per patient-hour at a fixed event recall [ Hyland and others, 2020 ] . Security work compares attacks by their
true-positive rate at a low false-positive rate, which AUROC hides [ Carlini et al., 2022 ] . Kamran et al. [2024] report that the Epic
Sepsis Model reaches an AUROC of 0.87 0.87 over all its predictions, but 0.62 0.62 on

order), suggesting that it partly reacts to clinicians’ suspicion. A

adjudicated onset, sorting each alarm as before, around or after it, and
reporting false alarms at the chosen threshold. For dialogs and agent
trajectories, Baidya et al. [2026] compare failure alerts by their
trade-off between accuracy and earliness, measured as the trigger turn over the
trajectory length.

Activation steering can be applied only when a condition read from the activations holds [ Lee et al., 2025 ] or when a calibrated estimate says it will reduce the error [ Hedström et al., 2025 ] , and a model can be trained to discard an unsafe
partial response and regenerate it [ Zhang and others, 2025 ] . For
degeneration, Xie et al. [2025] cut the trace and regenerate once a loop
is detected. These interventions act on a failure that is already under way or
on a prediction made from the prompt, and acting on a warning raised before the
onset of degeneration is left to future work. To make the warning easier to
read, low-rank adapters [ Hu et al., 2022 ] can be trained in the layers below a
linear probe jointly with it, which raises the AUROC of hallucination probes [ Obeso et al., 2025 ] . Fine-tuning tends to strengthen mechanisms the model
already has [ Prakash et al., 2024 ] , but it can also change what a probe
reads, to the point of hiding a harmful state from it [ Bailey and others, 2026 ] .

blocks.en:
The judge receives only the original prompt and generated completion; it does
not observe any of the heuristic repetition scores used elsewhere in our
analysis. We use the following system prompt:

You are judging whether a language model’s completion degenerated into
repetitive, low-information text (looping on a phrase, sentence, or pattern
without making progress), as opposed to repetition that is a normal, expected
part of the task. You will see both the prompt and the completion -- read the
prompt first, since it changes what counts as degeneration. Two things that look repetitive but are NOT degeneration: 1. Genuine incremental work. Brute-force search, case enumeration, or a
step-by-step derivation often produces a fixed template with a changing value
each time (e.g. ‘‘N = 41: ...’’ then ‘‘N = 42: ...’’ then ‘‘N = 43: ...’’).
This is fine as long as each occurrence is doing new work -- checking a new
candidate, advancing to the next step, covering a new case. A useful test: if
you deleted every occurrence but the first, would the completion lose
information needed to solve the task? If yes, it’s legitimate enumeration, not
degeneration. Only flag it if the ‘‘progress’’ is illusory -- e.g. it starts
re-checking values it already covered, drifts into a template that stops
advancing, or cycles without ever converging on an answer. 2. Instructed repetition. If the prompt itself asks for repeated output (e.g.
‘‘repeat X ten times’’, ‘‘write a line for each of the following ...’’),
producing that repetition is correct instruction-following, not degeneration --
unless the completion overruns what was asked (keeps going well past the
requested count) or the repetition itself becomes corrupted or loops in a way
the prompt didn’t ask for. Completions are all hard-capped at the same fixed max-token budget. A
completion that ends abruptly mid-sentence, mid-word, or mid-token is expected
simply because it hit that cap -- this is not, by itself, evidence of
degeneration one way or the other. Judge based on the quality and content of
the text alone, not on whether or how it was cut off.

blocks.en: All training strategies train the probe of Section 3 with binary cross-entropy, AdamW at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the probe and 10 − 5 10^{-5} for the LoRA adapters, with LoRA rank 16 16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 and dropout 0.05 0.05 , no weight decay, gradient clipping at norm 1 1 , 3,000 3{,}000 steps of 4,096 4{,}096 tokens, and three seeds. Healthy responses are subsampled to four per degenerate response, stratified by source, and a quarter of the supervised positions in each batch are positive. The loss weights positive targets by the ratio of negative to positive targets in the training set. Every probe is evaluated on the validation split every 100 100 steps, and the selected strategy, frontier_window centred on the onset with a window of 512 512 tokens and a hard target with K = 256 K=256 , draws the supervised positions of a healthy response from a window at a random position. The strategies differ along two axes. Token selection decides which positions are supervised. all_tokens uses every position, rollout_balanced samples the same number of positions from each response, random_window samples one contiguous window, and frontier_window places the window of a degenerate response around the onset, either centred on it or ending at it (trailing), and samples it at random in a healthy response. The target is either hard, positive from K K tokens before the onset, or soft, rising towards the onset with an exponential or linear decay over λ \lambda tokens. The four scorers of Figure 2 reach almost the same AUROC (0.9980 to 0.9998) but differ several-fold in warning coverage.
A response-level metric scores each response only by its highest token score, max t ⁡ s t \max_{t}s_{t} , so it cannot see when a scorer fires. Table 4 shows how far apart two scorers with the same AUROC can be.
From each probe we build two scorers that keep the highest score of every response, and so also its AUROC and calibrated threshold at persistence m = 1 m=1 , but move its other flags to opposite extremes. Shuffled permutes the scores within each response, which spreads the flags over the whole response, including its first tokens. Argmax only sets every score except the highest to the minimum, which leaves at most one flag per response, usually deep inside the loop. Table 4 is computed at β = 1 % \beta=1\% .

blocks.en: A.10 Representations before and after adaptation
blocks.zh: A.10 适应前后的表述

blocks.en:
Figure 6 follows one degenerate response per model through the
three probes of Section 4.4 . For each probe we take the residual
stream of the response at the layer the probe reads, with that probe’s adapters
for the two adapted ones, and project every token onto the first two principal
components of the response. In the frozen model, the tokens before the warning
window, in it and after the onset overlap in this plane. After adaptation they
fall in largely separate regions, most clearly at the adapted probe’s own layer,
with the warning window between the other two. The two components also explain
more of the variance after adaptation, 26 26 – 49 % 49\% against 11 11 – 20 % 20\% , so the
split between the three regions becomes one of the main directions of variation.
This is the intuition behind the gain in warning coverage of Section 4.4 .
